notes.title: Pandora: Chains of Chaos V1.4 Update is Now Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers! ☂️

It's been a couple of moons, but we're so excited to show you what we've been working on!

Our focus for this update was really improving game performance with key bug fixes, introducing new enemies, and diving deep into enhancing both the gameplay experience and world immersion.

Let us know what you think of the update and, as always, if you come across any more [strike]spiders[/strike] bugs, we’re here to squash them!

We can't thank you enough for your support 🐷

The Pandora: Chains of Chaos V1.4 update includes...
New Features ✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32279111/77368e9f32edd47fce36c24f92ae6d19b7f44d22.png


 A new mob added. Demon Watcher! This creature attacks you by flying into you and punching you with one of its 8 arms. We’ll be coming back to this in the future to improve the movement of the DW.
 A new mob added, spider bug! We’ve replaced the old bugs are we didn’t have any idle, attack or die animations. 
Maybe a spider queen will appear in the next update...
 Added reverb to outside areas.
 Completed an audio mix.
 VO for Hera added in!

Bug Fixes

 Targeting now works on all enemies.
 Ogre is now updated and has a working health bar. Ogre now also has hit reactions and doesn’t die facing down.
 Spells on the HUD have been removed as you can’t currently use them. |This will be back soon with better working spells and VFX!
 Collision issues fixed around the map. More to come.
 Pig rider models are now not of Pandora. We’ve updated the textures.
 Day and night cycle has been adjusted. There is more time during the day and night now the Sun and Moon move slower through the sky.
 There is now a marketplace to check out. We’ll be filling up this area with quests and NPC’s to talk to in the future.
 Butterflies were causing lag when you got close to them. This has been updated now so it shouldn’t happen.
 Framerate issues within the world
 New splash screen implemented.
 Combat tutorials have been adjusted to start when combat starts.
 New updated tutorials.
 Updated interaction button.
 Collision issues fixed around the map. More to come...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32279111/11cec9fea3d43e222f0ad4b6eb5b0e7f342ee815.png

Let us know your thoughts or of any issues via Steam forums or join our Discord server (currently undergoing renovations👷🛠️) 

Don't forget to follow us on Twitter!

See you next time! 🌠

Mivi
Community Manager

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.3
notes.notes:
Hey all!

It's been a long time since we've updated the game and a lot has changed! We really wanted to focus on all the bugs you've all found so far, so we made an effort to improve the quality of life bugs! We do hope you've been enjoying the game so far, so please let us know how the update is! And if you've found any more pesky bugs!

Thank you all for your support 

Fixes and Changes


 Two new missions added.

 Settings have now been added. 
Low spec machines can now change their settings by pressing Esc and navigating to the settings panel. it's a bit rough at the moment but we'll be adding more options over time!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32279111/13e60330168a11e12ef61c9fd960aeb1c5b2fa57.jpg

 You can now view Pandora's stats in the pause menu. This includes her strength and health along with how much exp you need to level up.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32279111/172ff2e40abc78c184269102f8a03544d07815ba.jpg

 Inventory items now show in the inventory section. Picking up scrolls and treasure from chests will automatically go there. 
(There's also a bug were look at fixing which duplicates inventory text on another item.)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32279111/e3ca505721154bfeac783fbc953f8568715e4e1d.jpg

 You can now close the treasure chest menu with the mouse on the cross button or by pressing escape. 
We finally fixed it!!

 You can now scroll the chests/scrolls popup.

 Various level design fixes with collision. You'll mostly notice this on the stairs when going up them.

 Updated a new area above Kome village with new monsters and temples and caves added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32279111/6770b62f4a74c8a05aec9defa778a3d28b4cf2a1.png

 Updated scrolls added around the map.

 Fixed a bug with the main menu showing continue even if the player did not have a save.

 Mission text updated to reflect the mission correctly.

 Pig gate adjusted so the player can get out on the pig.

 NPCs have been swapped in and assigned to the correct NPCs.

 Temple area adjusted to have an updated front.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32279111/65c7a8e66ad3242bb7f0e172e7cdf3da29907650.png

 You can now enter the temple area. New mission in here and we'll be adding more to this location soon.

 Fishing market area should now be accessible. 
Before the player couldn't access this area. Check it out!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32279111/35d70e1387a9336a9e0015bbde5a6c55c205ca67.png

 Adjusted the water for performance issues.


You'll find these changes are live now!

Keep telling us about any issues in the Steam forums or join our Discord https://discord.gg/6WSRP2jFq9!

Don't forget to follow us on twitter! https://twitter.com/PartyLlamaGames

Alyssa
Community Manager

notes.title: Pandora Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Hello Lil Llamas!

It's been a long time since we've given an update, but we have a great update for you all. busy. We promise. And we can show you our update gameplay video!
[previewyoutube=j9Bj57h2-j8;full][/previewyoutube]

One of the biggest things that have changed in the latest version is the art style. You can see we've chosen brighter colours and strong contrast. We feel it brings out the uniqueness of the world out where the characters can stand out a lot more. Let us know your feedback, we'd love to know what you think!

Over time, we started to realise that making the game in the blueprint was something that wouldn't work long term. Especially for performance. Over the past 6 months, we've been swapping over the old blueprint to code. This has also allowed us to rework some systems, but also to think about the direction of the gameplay. While we've kept most of the gameplay the same, we have introduced some new mechanics and updating the combat to be more interesting. You can see the seeds of this in the video above. Over the next few months we'll be showing more of these systems when they come to life. Some of them are:

Magic
Each magic ability does something different rather then just causing damage.


 Lighting - Stuns one enemy on the battlefield
 This goes to all enemies in the area of the target when use the ultimate.
 Water - Heals Pandora for 30%
 This % can be increased by skill points on the tree.
 Using the ultimate would cause for this to expand to other members of the party.


Ultimates on Umbrellas
 
New combo attacks.
[/b

]Make sure to follow us to keep up to date!

Nareice

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.5
notes.notes:
Hey Llamas,

We hope you've been enjoying the demo and the last update we did for it. We're back again with a few small changes that not only impact the demo, but the main game as well. We've been focusing a lot on gameplay changes with the character but also fixing up a few stray bugs we've seen when watching players play Pandora.

Not only have we been fixing the game up, but we've updated our promotion art and website! Make sure you take a look and find out about the team who works on the game.

Keep and eye out for our first dev blog post which will delve deeper into what we're planning for Pandora and when we'll be opening Pandora up for Closed Beta on PC. Want a gander at the pre alpha build? Make sure to join our Discord server here: https://discord.gg/3fjf8zN

Fixes


 Last attack of combo does bonus damage.
 Slideshow now advances by the E key.
 Glow effect removed on Pandora.
 Fix for focus problem when using Mouse and Keyboard.
 Strafing enabled when locked onto a target.
 Out of combat Regen is now affecctive.  10 seconds out of combat and the player starts to Regen health.


We'll be back soon with another update!

Nareice, Party Llama Games

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.4
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to our first update for the demo!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32279111/22b1377cc0b1447e2d1363669814c29ff140c95f.png
The demo has been out for a few weeks now, and we've learnt a lot from the feedback we've been given so far. We're hard at work on combat changes, a new targeting system and updated missions. We'll be getting these changes to you in the next few weeks.

Bug Fixes
Goblin fix - He should no longer follow you around after a set distance.
Texture Fixes - Some textures were a little blurry. Now fixed at the correct resolution.
Sky is now in night time mode for the story.
Mounted jump fix.  Mounted jump was blending with the walking jump.
Pig jump not ending.  Makes it look like they're running when they're not.
Lock on hints are now view able at the start.
Gliding hint is now view able at start.
Sprint fix.  Running with weapon was faster than running without.
Collision size changes on some objects. 
Level cleanup around Kome Village
Player optimisation. We made it better for 
Integrating Discord. We've starting adding where the player is and what they are doing while playing in the world of Pandora.
Targeting changes. Players can now auto lock and lock on
Animation work on Pandora's animations. We've fixed up a few transitions when attacking with the Umbrella and Standing attacks with control.
Camera fixes - The camera should not longer go underneath the floor.


We'll be back soon with another update!

Party Llama

notes.title: Demo 0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32279111/d969d933dccd5da63dbe52b940a2fdb89ed5f024.png

Hey there Llamas!

Welcome to our first bout of patch notes for our demo we released last week.
Below you'll find a list of bugs we've fixed and features we've updated.

Bug Fixes


 Main objective widget now shows until it's done. Players were confused about what the mission actually was.
 Mount widget cue was missing from the pig when attempting to ride it.
 Bug particle effect killed on death. It seemed to be left in the world.
 Fishing rod orientation was rotated 180 degrees.
 Minimap border was being hidden. It now shows correctly.
 Icon changes on the actual game. They now show on the taskbar and desktop.
 Music and sfx are now controlled by volume controls in audio options menu
 Fixed issue of music not fading out when quitting back to the main menu


Demo Changes


 Path will now redo every six seconds.  It's on for 3.  Also wave mobs will cause the path.
 Fire damage now happens on Pandora.
 Wave changes: Player no longer has to go through a large amount of mobs in each mission.
 Cerberus stats changed to have more health and give 200XP on defeating.
 Faster moving attacks and the player is no longer being held to stand still and attack.
 Changed the lock on ability to cycle through the closest three.
 Opening slideshow with story content added. This will give the player some information on what happened before Pandora opened the box.
